payerId.description: The PayPal-assigned ID for the payer

email.description: The email address of the payer.

paymentStatus.description:
The status of the captured payment.

The possible values are:

* COMPLETED. The funds for this captured payment were credited to the payee's PayPal account.
* DECLINED. The funds could not be captured.
* PENDING. The funds for this captured payment was not yet credited to the payee's PayPal account. A manual review might be pending.
* FAILED. There was an error while capturing payment.
